name: meridian
description: Meridian FDE Project - ticketing + case-summariser platform (offline + AWS)

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared-types && npm run build --workspace=backend && npm run build --workspace=frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared-types && npm run typecheck --workspace=backend && npm run typecheck --workspace=frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=backend && npm run lint --workspace=frontend
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=backend && npm run test --workspace=frontend
scripts.test:coverage: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared-types && npm run test:coverage --workspace=backend && npm run test:coverage --workspace=frontend
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:coverage
